MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) whose Object or Scene contains this Annotation.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) whose Object or Scene contains this Annotation.

AnnotationJSONText.description: JSON text of the Annotation, conforming to the JSON Schema of the annotated Item.

AnnotationSpaceTime.description: Space and Time where and when this Annotation item is attached within the Object or Scene or other data.

ProcessActions.description: Permitted actions on the annotated Data.

ProcessActionID.description: Identifier of a permitted Process Action on the annotated Data.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Annotation in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Annotation (plain text, max 2048 characters).
